primitives.name: Temporal Error Correction Loop
primitives.verbatim_quote: In thinking over the game with the idea of criticising it, the men will be much impressed and better prepared for the future.
primitives.assumptions: Players' cognitive engagement with prior performance improves subsequent decision-making; feedback delay is negligible.

primitives.name: Structured Mistake Analysis
primitives.verbatim_quote: MONDAY On Monday evening the coach should require each of the men at the training quarters to present two written criticisimns of the game played the Saturday before, the statements to bring out the mistakes that were made and the remedies which should be applied in particular instances.
primitives.assumptions: Written critique enhances analytical depth beyond verbal discussion; individual accountability increases learning efficiency.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When critiques lack specificity or fail to distinguish between personal and team errors.

layer2.mapping: Kernel of error categorization maps to state-space projection of tactical misalignment in action space.
layer2.telemetry: Number of unique error types identified per player, remedy implementation rate.

primitives.name: Tactical Review Framework
primitives.verbatim_quote: The field for review should consist of the mistakes made by the individuals, the mistakes in team play and the manner and spirit in which the gane was played.
primitives.assumptions: Holistic review includes both technical and psychological dimensions of performance; multidimensional error space is fully enumerable.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When focus narrows exclusively to individual or team aspects without integrating behavioral ethos.

layer2.mapping: Framework aligns with multi-objective optimization problem where objectives are error reduction, coordination, and morale.
layer2.telemetry: Aggregate score across three domains (individual, team, spirit), normalized against baseline performance.

Structured mistake analysis provides the data necessary for this update, forming a kernel of actionable insights. Failure occurs when feedback is not systematically integrated into practice, leading to repeated errors and stagnation.
